name: RS
summary: A yoga master capable of stretching his limbs across the screen and floating mid-air to dodge attacks.

source.parsed_text:
RS is ...


Special moves:
- Long range kick, as a yoga master his legs stretch almost across the entire screen to try and hit you.
- Yogo flight, when done mid jump allows him to float mid air for a few seconds.  Useful for dodging an oncoming attack.  Floats with legs criss crossed sitting style.

inferred_stats.reason: Yoga mastery provides discipline and body control, balancing range with flexibility.
